There are no motion, pacing or screen-text lines and no MP4 hash in it, and its diff against HEAD drops 6 lines. I found no Whisper receipt for v9; only whisper-v9-draft.json exists. Treat motion, pacing and mix transcription as pending, not passed.
2. [Low, S36 mid/end] The '6–12 months?' label overlaps the cube grid; the '6' is partly covered by a cube. It looks the same in v8, so it's not a regression. I only saw this at sheet scale, not at 100%.
3. [Low, narration L36] The source (C15 excerpt) says a swarm 'could be capable of taking over the entire internet with a persistent botnet', conditioned on the 'rate of AI capability development'. The narration says 'could take over the whole internet', which drops 'be capable of' and the botnet mechanism. That's slightly stronger than the source. 'That's his forecast, and people dispute it' softens it. Wording fix if wanted: 'could be capable of taking over…'.
4. [Unresolved, narration L25 / S25] The C11 excerpt is cut off at 'Claude Opus 5 and Claude Mythos 5.1 engaged in these behaviors ro…'. I couldn't confirm 'about thirty percent' or 'Anthropic isn't sure how far that carries over' from the excerpt. Both need checking in the full Anthropic page (alignment-assessment-cybersecurity-incidents, the CTF replication paragraph). I didn't open it, to avoid downloading. S25-mid shows 11%/11% while the bars count up to 30%; that's a normal middle state, and the end frame reads 80/30/30 (approx.).
5. [Cosmetic, S07-end, S28-end, S32-end, S38-end] The yellow highlight bars run past the end of the text line. Same in v8.
6. [Low, template] The template is at templates/video/tasks/final-review-task.md, not at the templates/video root. The AGENTS.md lines 104-106 link to tasks/, so the link is consistent. What's missing:

   - (b) it doesn't ask for the prior version's sheets to be opened to check for regressions, only 'Prior export' as an input;
   - (c) it names animated text and caret checks but not label association, closing or terminal frames, or narration-to-picture coherence;

   No overclaims found. It keeps pending checks pending, and it keeps playback/listening separate from stills.
